technical_and_design_decisions: Extend existing Spring Integration Kafka module (spring-integration-kafka) rather than creating new module
Use Spring Boot auto-configuration and @ConfigurationProperties for global Kafka defaults with per-deployment overrides via Spring profiles or @Primary beans
Leverage Kafka consumer group concurrency via Spring Integration's ConcurrentMessageListenerContainer
Implement compression using Kafka producer config (compression.type) exposed via Spring Boot properties
Message ACK support via Spring Integration's AcknowledgmentCallback and Kafka's manual offset commit
Implement bindRequestor/bindReplier using Spring Integration's Messaging Gateway and request-reply pattern with Kafka reply topics
Batching support via Kafka producer batch.size/linger.ms and Spring Integration's MessageGroupProcessor
Sqoop integration via Sqoop Java API (org.apache.sqoop.Sqoop) with ProcessBuilder fallback for CLI
Sqoop job stop via Sqoop's job management API or process termination with SIGTERM
Sqoop log capture via ProcessBuilder redirectErrorStream and custom Log4j2 appender streaming to SLF4J
Incremental load using Sqoop's --incremental mode with last-value tracking in persistent store (JDBC/Redis)
Acceptance tests using Testcontainers for Kafka and Sqoop (Hadoop pseudo-distributed mode)
Configuration metadata via spring-configuration-metadata.json for IDE support
assumptions: Existing codebase is Spring Integration 6.x / Spring Framework 6.x with Java 17 baseline
Spring Integration Kafka module already exists with basic producer/consumer support
Sqoop integration module exists or will be created as spring-integration-sqoop
Kafka client version 3.5+ compatible with Spring 6
Sqoop version 1.4.7+ with Hadoop 3.x runtime available in CI
CI/CD pipeline uses GitHub Actions or GitLab CI with Docker/Testcontainers support
Development team has 2+ years experience with Spring, Kafka, and Sqoop
No major refactoring of existing Kafka/Sqoop adapter code required
Acceptance tests run in CI with embedded Kafka (Testcontainers) and Hadoop pseudo-distributed mode for Sqoop
Documentation updates target Spring Integration reference guide (AsciiDoc)
Code review process requires 1-2 reviewers per PR
All new features require unit tests (80%+ coverage) and integration tests

activities.activity_name: Design Kafka Concurrency and Compression Configuration Model
activities.activity_description: Design configuration classes, properties binding, and extension points for global defaults with per-deployment overrides for concurrency (consumer threads, prefetch) and compression (codec, batch settings).

activities.activity_name: Implement Global Kafka Configuration Defaults
activities.activity_description: Create Spring Boot @ConfigurationProperties classes for Kafka producer/consumer defaults, register auto-configuration, and ensure backward compatibility.

activities.activity_name: Implement Per-Deployment Override Mechanism
activities.activity_description: Implement override mechanism using Spring profiles, @ConditionalOnProperty, and @Primary beans to allow deployment-specific Kafka settings.

activities.activity_name: Implement Kafka Concurrency Support
activities.activity_description: Enhance Kafka message listener container configuration to support configurable concurrency (consumer threads), prefetch counts, and partition assignment strategies.

activities.activity_name: Implement Kafka Compression Support
activities.activity_description: Expose Kafka producer compression settings (compression.type, batch.size, linger.ms) via configuration properties and apply to Spring Integration Kafka outbound channel adapters.

activities.activity_name: Implement Message ACK Mechanism
activities.activity_description: Add manual offset commit support via AcknowledgmentCallback, configure enable.auto.commit=false, and provide acknowledgment API for inbound Kafka messages.

activities.activity_name: Implement bindRequestor and bindReplier for Request-Reply
activities.activity_description: Create Messaging Gateway implementations for requestor (producer expecting async replies) and replier (consumer handling requests and sending replies) using Kafka reply topics and correlation IDs.

activities.activity_name: Implement Kafka Batching Support
activities.activity_description: Add batching configuration for producers (batch.size, linger.ms) and consumers (max.poll.records), implement MessageGroupProcessor for batch ingestion, and support @BatchListener.

activities.activity_name: Write Unit Tests for Kafka Features
activities.activity_description: Develop unit tests for all new Kafka configuration classes, concurrency logic, compression settings, ACK handling, request-reply gateways, and batching processors using Mockito and embedded Kafka.

activities.activity_name: Write Integration Tests for Kafka Features
activities.activity_description: Create integration tests with Testcontainers Kafka cluster verifying end-to-end concurrency, compression, ACK, request-reply, and batching scenarios.

activities.activity_name: Write Acceptance Tests for Kafka (U1)
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance test suite for Kafka message bus covering all user stories (U1-U5) as executable specifications for CI pipeline.

activities.activity_name: Design Sqoop Job Control and Logging Integration
activities.activity_description: Design Sqoop job management API wrapper, process lifecycle control, log capture architecture, and incremental load state persistence strategy.

activities.activity_name: Implement Stop Sqoop Job Functionality
activities.activity_description: Implement job termination via Sqoop Java API (SqoopTool) and fallback process destruction, with resource cleanup hooks and callback notifications.

activities.activity_name: Implement Sqoop Log Capture and Streaming
activities.activity_description: Create ProcessBuilder-based log capture with custom Log4j2 appender streaming Sqoop stdout/stderr to SLF4J/Logback, supporting structured logging and log levels.

activities.activity_name: Implement Incremental Data Load for Sqoop
activities.activity_description: Implement incremental import using Sqoop's --incremental modes (append/lastmodified), persistent last-value store (JDBC/Redis), and configuration for column/check-column.

activities.activity_name: Write Unit Tests for Sqoop Features
activities.activity_description: Develop unit tests for Sqoop job control, log capture, incremental load state management using mocked Sqoop API and embedded Hadoop.

activities.activity_name: Write Integration Tests for Sqoop Features
activities.activity_description: Create integration tests with Testcontainers Hadoop/Sqoop verifying job stop, log streaming, and incremental load end-to-end.

activities.activity_name: Update Documentation
activities.activity_description: Update Spring Integration reference documentation (AsciiDoc) with new Kafka configuration options, request-reply patterns, batching, and Sqoop adapter usage.

activities.activity_name: CI/CD Pipeline Updates for Acceptance Tests
activities.activity_description: Configure CI pipeline to run Kafka and Sqoop acceptance tests with Testcontainers, publish test reports, and gate merges on test success.

activities.activity_name: Code Review and Merge Activities
activities.activity_description: Conduct code reviews for all feature PRs, address feedback, resolve merge conflicts, and ensure compliance with contribution guidelines.
